theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (x : Euclidean N) (s : Finset (Euclidean N)) (Θ : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞) (K c δ ε : ℝ) (M : ℕ), 0 ≤ K → 0 ≤ c → 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 / 2 → 0 < ε → ε ≤ δ ^ 4 → (2 + 2 * c + 2 * c / (unitBallVolume n).toReal + 2 * (M : ℝ) * K / (unitBallVolume n).toReal) * δ ≤ 1 → 2 ≤ s.card → s.card ≤ M → (∀ y ∈ s, ‖y - x‖ < ε ∧ ∀ τ σ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < σ → σ < 1 → Θ y ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ε) * (μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 4 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n) + ENNReal.ofReal (K * ε * σ / τ)) / unitBallVolume n) → (∀ σ τ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ δ ^ 2 → 2 * δ ^ 2 * σ ≤ τ → (∀ y ∈ s, ∀ y' ∈ s, y ≠ y' → 4 * τ ≤ ‖y - y'‖) → ∑ y ∈ s, μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + c * δ ^ 2) * μ (closedBall x 1) + ENNReal.ofReal (c * δ ^ 2)) → ∑ y ∈ s, Θ y ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * μ (closedBall x 1) / unitBallVolume n + ENNReal.ofReal δ
